items.description: Every directory under docs/ in the primary worktree that the last refresh listed, ordered by path. No directory is listed to answer the read.

complete.description: False when the last refresh could not read, or stopped part of the way through, docs or a directory under it in the primary worktree: one it could not open, one deeper than it goes, a symbolic link, or the place where it met its limit on entries. Folders may then be missing while index.state is current.
